    publication: (X) => Object.assign(_, X),
    management: (X) => Object.assign(j, X),
    review: (X) => Object.assign(ae, X),
    loading: (X) => {
      w.loading = X;
    },
    status: (X, ge = !1) => {
      w.statusMessage = X, w.statusError = !!ge, X && vc(X, ge ? "error" : "info"), ge && w.view === "base-map-editor" && (H.message = X), ge && w.view === "mapview-editor" && (V.message = X);
    },
    accountDirty: () => q.accountDirty(),
    sync({ current: X, view: ge, busy: Oe, feedback: Fe = "global" }) {
      Object.assign(w, {
        authenticated: !!X,
        mustChange: !!X?.user.mustChangePassword,
        admin: X?.user.role === "admin",
        account: X?.user.account ?? "",
        view: ge,
        busy: Oe,
        feedback: Fe
      });
    }
  });
}
export {
  gL as createAccountController,
  mL as createBaseMapWorkbench,
  vL as createBaseStrongholdWorkbench,
  hL as createCopyController,
  yL as createGameMapWorkbench,
  wL as mountWorkbench
};
